question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

My uncle is someone __who loves good food and knows a lot about it__.
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Gourmet.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The context of the sentence is that the speaker's uncle loves good food and has knowledge about good food. • Let's look at the meaning of the marked option: • **Gourmet** - a person who is knowledgeable about good food and drink. (भोजन एवं पेय से संबंधित ज्ञानवान) • Example: • *The couple shares a love of **gourmet** cooking.* • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • **Connoisseur** - an expert in a particular field, especially in matters of art or taste. (कला या स्वाद के मामलों में विशेषज्ञ) • **Chauffeur** - a person employed to drive a private or hired car. (निजी या किराए पर ली गई कार चलाने के लिए नियुक्त व्यक्ति) • **Culinary** - related to cooking or the kitchen. (रसोई खाने पकाने से संबंधित) • Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Gourmet' is the correct one-word substitute. • So, the correct answer is option 2. 2f:T8b81,
